_comment: The Deep Research RL environment. The tool list is explicit rather than a wildcard on purpose: this preset defines a task, and a task whose action space changes when someone drops in a new tool is not reproducible. Every result the project reports names this preset and a corpus hash; both have to be pinned for that pair to mean anything. max_steps is the environment's episode limit — changing it changes the task.
name: deepresearch
label: 深研场
description: 冻结论文语料上的多跳检索任务环境，用于 RL 训练与评测。只有检索、打开与作答三个动作，不联网、不读写文件。
